ceiling_audit.operationalization: Every globally consistent relative order among AUROC==1 cells is placed above all finite cells; the exact 120-permutation Spearman test is recomputed for each order.

For each globally consistent relative order among AUROC==1 cells, only those ceiling ties are broken in the same order in every source block and above every finite cell; non-ceiling values and their ties are preserved before recomputing the exact Page test.
